== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Greedo (Japanese)|Greedo]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/jp/imagegallery/4722 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 135901774.

Crop rectangle <code>(129, 616, 1298, 2242)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>afb1bdf611a8d8f30d1a9028ce06e15478b222bf07c82628ac804449e49d5550</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
